propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through one Pydantic Agent operation with a shared request budget, verified by retry-contract tests covering tool turns, output retries, and exhaustion.
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses on proven fit; the complete input, accepted output, and stored history must never be truncated.

Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and answering-model provenance across the Pydantic native implementation.
Successful operations must report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once; fallback/downgrade candidates must remain trace or journal events rather than competing usage counters.
The bespoke structured-output retry loop can only be removed after compatibility suite and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass verification.
